deposits.incidental: Body does not match the deposit title. Title and frontmatter name the emoji work 'question-mark 24 calendar = question-mark' (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18512289, Ichabod Spellings), but the canonical bytes below the rule (lines 46-1671) are the whole CRIMSON HEXAGON / NH-OS DOI REGISTRY v7.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19055255, Lee Sharks), recovered from the blog post .../crimson-hexagon-nh-os-doi-registry-v70.html. The emoji work itself appears only as a one-line registry precis (lines 173, 177, 810, 1360). The recovery note's body-head gate pass looks mistaken: wrong body for this deposit. The registry also lists, as one-line precis only, deposits that later readers may want for the sweep: 'The Silent Migration: A Speculative Architectural Forecast' (10.5281/zenodo.18157917, line 930); 'The Shark That Preceded Itself' novelty-of-terms claim (10.5281/zenodo.18807239, lines 463, 1498); MRA-2025-1224-STABILIZATION 'validating retrocausal canon formation' (10.5281/zenodo.18369038, line 1222). These are catalogue summaries of other deposits, not this text's own claims, so they are not recorded as finds here. Open items/queued list (lines 1628-1653) is procedural backlog, not recorded.
